title: Model Harmony: bulk-pin + quick-create endpoint wireflow (annotated draft)
content:
Purpose
-----
This doc captures a working sketch + microcopy variants for two related flows: 1) bulk-pin management from the model catalog (bulk actions across search/filter results), and 2) a fast endpoint-create flow that surfaces safe model version pinning decisions inline (compact modal + conflict handling). Goal is to produce a single, scannable wireflow and a short list of copy options we can A/B in usability tests and backlog grooming.

TL;DR (what I'm proposing)
- Add a bulk-select + pin action on the catalog list that can pin selected models to existing endpoints or create new endpoints from a template in one quick path.
- Endpoint QuickCreate flow: condensed three-step drawer (name -> select model+version -> runtime options) with an inline "pin modal" that presents clear defaults, consequences, and an explicit rollback fallback option.
- Provide copy variants for critical touchpoints: bulk pin confirmation, version conflict warning, and pinned-version badges.

User problems addressed
- Teams currently click into model pages one-by-one to pin them; this is slow when creating many similar endpoints.
- Pinning is opaque: users are unsure what happens when a pinned model is updated upstream or when a version is rolled out.
- Endpoint creation has duplicate fields compared to endpoint templates; users want a fast, repeatable path for common configs.

Personas in mind
- Platform engineer (SRE-ish): needs bulk operations to manage large fleets of endpoints; cares about safety and audit trails.
- Product ML engineer: wants to experiment with multiple model variants quickly and compare outputs.
- Product engineer: needs a fast, low-friction create path with sensible defaults.

Constraints / Principles
- Safety-first: default to non-destructive actions and require explicit confirmation for changes that affect live traffic.
- Lightweight: the quick-create should be <= 3 steps and not require leaving the catalog context.
- Observable: every bulk-pin action must create an audit event and optionally link to rollout config.

Wireflow (annotated, step-by-step)
1) Catalog list view (compact rows)
   - Left: multi-select checkbox column; middle: model card with name, short description, latest version badge; right: actions (quick create endpoint, view details, pin).
   - New: "Bulk actions" bar appears when >=1 selection. Primary action: 'Bulk pin / create endpoint' (primary), secondary: 'Export selection' (secondary).
   - Tooltip for 'pin' action on model row: 'Pining locks an endpoint to this model version. Use for production endpoints.'

2) Bulk-pin modal (appears from toolbar)
   - Header: 'Bulk pin: select target endpoints'
   - Body: two tabbed options: 'Pin to existing endpoints' | 'Create new endpoints'
   - Existing endpoints tab: searchable drop-down with small table (endpoint name, region, current model). Rows show compatibility hints (green check / amber warning).
   - Create new tab: compact form (endpoint name pattern with token substitution e.g. {{model-name}}-{{env}}, region, runtime profile preset). Default toggle: 'Create as pinned (recommended)'.
   - Microcopy variants for a risky case (if user selects models with different architectures): show inline warning: 'Selected models include different architectures. Some endpoints may not be compatible with all models.'

3) Endpoint QuickCreate drawer (from a single model card action)
   - Step 1: Name & template (pre-filled suggested name: 'svc-{{model-short}}-v1') + environment toggle (dev/staging/prod).
   - Step 2: Model selection (model dropdown with version selector). Default selects the catalog row's version; 'Pin to this version' checkbox visible with help text.
   - Step 3: Runtime options (preset list: low-latency, balanced, throughput). 'Advanced' collapsible for batching, kv-cache, quantization profile.
   - Final screen: Review & create. Includes a compact pin summary: 'This endpoint will serve model: name (pinned to vX)'. CTA: 'Create endpoint' and secondary: 'Create + open endpoint'.

Annotated UI elements and copy (variants)
- Bulk Pin Modal title variants
  * Variant A: 'Bulk pin: target endpoints'
  * Variant B: 'Apply model versions to endpoints'
  * Variant C (concise): 'Bulk pin models'
  Preferred tone: A (clear action + object).

- Bulk Pin confirmation body variants
  * V1: 'Pinning will lock selected endpoints to the chosen model versions. Live traffic will start serving the pinned versions immediately.'
  * V2: 'Pins are version locks. Future model updates will not affect pinned endpoints unless explicitly rolled out.'
  * V3 (more reassuring): 'Pins are reversible — you can rollback or create a canary rollout afterward.'
  Use a combination: short sentence + link to 'rollout & rollback help'.

- Pin modal CTA labels
  * Primary: 'Apply pins' | 'Confirm pins' | 'Pin and deploy'
  * Secondary: 'Cancel' | 'Save draft' (if creating endpoints)
  Recommend 'Apply pins' for clarity.

- Version conflict warning copy (inline)
  * Header: 'Version mismatch detected'
  * Body: 'Some selected endpoints currently serve model versions that are incompatible with the models you selected. Confirm to replace or choose a compatible variant.'
  * Action: 'Show compatibility details' (expands a small diff table).

- Pinned badge copy + tooltip
  * Badge: 'PINNED v1.4' (caps vs Title case?)
  * Tooltip text: 'This endpoint is pinned to model version v1.4. Automatic model upgrades will not change this endpoint.'

- Conflict resolution microcopy (three-way)
  * Overwrite option: 'Replace current version — immediate'
  * Canary option: 'Deploy as canary (10%) — gradual'
  * Skip option: 'Skip incompatible endpoints'

Audit & observability notes
- Every bulk-pin action must create a single audit record with: actor, timestamp, models affected, endpoints created/modified, and a rollback handle (ID).
- UI surfaces a short link to 'View audit' in the bulk action success toast.

Accessibility considerations
- Ensure the bulk modal supports keyboard-only multi-select and ARIA labels for compatibility hints.
- Color semantics for compatibility chips must have text equivalents (e.g., 'Compatible', 'Needs review').

Acceptance criteria (MVP)
1) Catalog list supports multi-select and shows bulk action bar.
2) Bulk-pin modal supports both 'pin to existing' and 'create new' flows.
3) QuickCreate drawer defaults sensible endpoint name and default pin checkbox.
4) Audit record generated for each bulk-pin action and accessible from the UI toast.
5) Basic conflict detection: show warning when architectures/sequence-length mismatches detected.

Backlog grooming notes (tickets, estimates, and priorities)
- PRJ-1428: Implement catalog multi-select UI and bulk action bar — 3 pts — P0
- PRJ-1431: Bulk-pin modal backend API + compatibility checker — 5 pts — P0
- PRJ-1433: Endpoint quick-create drawer UX + form validation — 3 pts — P1
- PRJ-1434: Pin audit event schema + UI toast link — 2 pts — P1
- PRJ-1436: Microcopy A/B test for pin confirmation modal — 1 pt — P2
(Estimates rough — groom in sprint planning)

Open questions / unresolved items
- Default behavior for mixed-architecture selections: should we block by default, or present 'skip incompatible' as preselected? (ops preference: block; experimentation preference: skip)
- How to surface rollout policies for pinned endpoints created in bulk? Do we create a default 'manual rollout' policy attached to the new endpoints?
- Should audit events created by bulk create be grouped under a single rollout entity for easier rollback?

Design follow-ups / next steps
- UX: produce hi-fi mocks for the bulk modal and quick-create drawer (Eric) — due 2025-02-09.
- Eng: scope API for bulk pinning and compatibility checks (Priya) — sync next grooming.
- Research: run 5 quick usability sessions with platform engineers on copy variants (Luca) — results by 2025-02-16.

Notes to self / rough ideas (brain dump)
- Could add 'pin templates' (named pin configs) so a team can reuse a set of runtime + pin defaults for many endpoints.
- Consider an 'undo window' (30s toast with undo) for bulk pin overwrite operations to reduce fear of destructive actions.
- For quick-create, add keyboard shortcut 'c' when a single model row is focused to jump into the quick-create drawer.

Appendix: quick microcopy snippets for engineers to drop in UI
- Quick create suggested name: 'svc-{{model_slug}}-{{env}}'
- Pin confirmation short: 'Pin model vX to endpoint — locks future model updates.'
- Success toast for bulk create: 'Created 12 endpoints and applied pins to 12 endpoints.\n View audit'
- Error toast: '2 endpoints failed: incompatible architecture.\n Show details'

End.
